description: Mark DeCaprio works for the people of our towns—working families, seniors, volunteer firefighters and EMS, veterans, parents, small businesses, farmers and rural communities. Mark is fighting to lower rising electric costs, hold the line on property taxes and make Connecticut more affordable. He will continue protecting local decision-making and opposing unnecessary state mandates that put additional burdens on our towns and taxpayers.
title: Mark's Record | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
